snow to work with at the start of shift, but as the night got colder it came good. McKay Loop and Pretty Valley Road to the cattle grid have been groomed and track set, this was done early in the shift so expect it to be very firm until it gets some sun. The Nordic Bowl has been flattened and groomed, High Plains Road has been groomed and track set, it's looking pretty good except for the first section at windy corner. Panorama Loop and the Boat Ramp have been groomed and track set, conditions look great. Pretty Valley Road from Aitkens down has been groomed and track set. Lower Horseyard Loop has been track set and groomed Aqueduct in the Nordic Bowl has been groomed and track set, as has the last 50 mtrs to the Dam Wall. Hoppet Start has been groomed, but only 1 pass. The inner trails were the last to be groomed so they should be great options for early morning.
